description: Defines a template class JSONValueConverter for converting JSON data into C++ structs, including registration of various field types and nested structures, with internal classes for handling different data conversions.

classes.name: JSONValueConverter
classes.description: Template class for converting JSON values into C++ structs with registration methods for various field types.

classes.name: internal::FieldConverterBase
classes.description: Base class for field converters, holding the field path and defining the interface for conversion.

classes.name: internal::ValueConverter
classes.description: Interface for converting a JSON value to a specific field type.

classes.name: internal::FieldConverter
classes.description: Template class for converting and assigning a JSON value to a struct field.

classes.name: internal::BasicValueConverter
classes.description: Specializations for converting basic types (int, string, u16string, double, bool).

classes.name: internal::ValueFieldConverter
classes.description: Converts a JSON value using a custom function.

classes.name: internal::CustomFieldConverter
classes.description: Converts a JSON value to a custom type using a string-based conversion function.

classes.name: internal::NestedValueConverter
classes.description: Handles nested JSON objects by delegating to another JSONValueConverter.

classes.name: internal::RepeatedValueConverter
classes.description: Converts JSON arrays into vectors of unique pointers to elements.

classes.name: internal::RepeatedMessageConverter
classes.description: Converts JSON arrays into vectors of nested message objects.

classes.name: internal::RepeatedCustomValueConverter
classes.description: Converts JSON arrays into vectors of nested objects using a custom conversion function.

methods.name: RegisterIntField
methods.description: Registers an integer field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterStringField
methods.description: Registers a string or u16string field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterBoolField
methods.description: Registers a boolean field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterDoubleField
methods.description: Registers a double field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterNestedField
methods.description: Registers a nested struct field for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterCustomField
methods.description: Registers a custom field with a string-based conversion function.

methods.name: RegisterCustomValueField
methods.description: Registers a custom field with a value-based conversion function.

methods.name: RegisterRepeatedString
methods.description: Registers a repeated string or u16string field.

methods.name: RegisterRepeatedCustomValue
methods.description: Registers a repeated custom value field.

methods.name: RegisterRepeatedMessage
methods.description: Registers a repeated nested message field.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a JSON value into a struct instance based on registered fields.
